title: should navigate to trace details from the expanded log row View Trace action
verifies: expanded-row JsonPreview shows the View Trace button and clicking it routes to traces/trace-details for the matching trace_id and renders the trace

title: should navigate to trace details from the row-detail drawer View Trace action
verifies: the drawer-header View Trace button navigates to traces/trace-details for the same trace (DetailTable no-payload emit path)

title: should hide the View Trace action when the record has no trace_id
verifies: neither the expanded-row nor drawer View Trace button renders when the record lacks a truthy trace_id

title: should render the traces-stream picker with a default stream selected in the detail drawer
verifies: the drawer traces-stream picker renders with a non-empty default (first traces stream) selection

title: should navigate without crashing when the trace_id does not resolve to a real trace
verifies: a log whose trace_id has no matching trace still routes to traces/trace-details and renders its empty/no-result state without crashing
